-- | The remaining parts of one match, each waiting for an enumeration hole.
type Pending = [(Template Symbol, UVar)]

-- | A partial term with explicit markers for unresolved holes and recursion.
type PartialTerm = CT.Term (PartialSymbol Symbol)

-- | Resume the parts whose holes now have the expanded representative.
resume :: UVar -> PartialTerm -> Pending -> EnumerateM Symbol (Maybe Pending)
resume current partial pending = fmap (fmap concat . sequence) (traverse part pending)
  where
    part (template, uv) = do
        representative <- getUVarRepresentative uv
        pure $
            if representative == current
                then matchPartial template partial
                else Just [(template, representative)]

{- | Match a partial term. Nothing rejects the match. An empty list proves
the match. A nonempty list records the parts that still need expansion.
-}
matchPartial :: Template Symbol -> PartialTerm -> Maybe Pending
matchPartial Hole _ = Just []
matchPartial (AnyPrefix []) _ = Just []
matchPartial template (CT.Node (UVarHole uv) []) = Just [(template, uv)]
matchPartial _ (CT.Node TruncatedRecursion _) = Nothing
matchPartial template (CT.Node (ConcreteSymbol symbol) children) = case template of
    AnyNode parts -> exact parts
    TemplateNode expected parts | expected == symbol -> exact parts
    AnyPrefix parts -> prefix parts
    TemplatePrefix expected parts | expected == symbol -> prefix parts
    _ -> Nothing
  where
    exact parts
        | length parts == length children = concat <$> zipWithM matchPartial parts children
        | otherwise = Nothing
    prefix parts
        | length parts <= length children = concat <$> zipWithM matchPartial parts children
        | otherwise = Nothing
matchPartial _ _ = Nothing

-- | Pattern over first-order terms.
data Template symbol
    = -- | Match any complete subtree.
      Hole
    | -- | Match any root symbol with exactly these children.
      AnyNode ![Template symbol]
    | -- | Match this root symbol with exactly these children.
      TemplateNode !symbol ![Template symbol]
    | -- | Match any root symbol whose children begin with this prefix.
      AnyPrefix ![Template symbol]
    | -- | Match this root symbol when its children begin with this prefix.
      TemplatePrefix !symbol ![Template symbol]
    deriving (Eq, Ord, Read, Show)

open Language

/-- Complete-subtree, exact-node, and prefix-node patterns. -/
inductive Pattern (Symbol : Type) where
  | hole
  | anyNode (children : List (Pattern Symbol))
  | node (symbol : Symbol) (children : List (Pattern Symbol))
  | anyPrefix (children : List (Pattern Symbol))
  | prefix (symbol : Symbol) (children : List (Pattern Symbol))

mutual
  /-- Execute complete-term template matching. -/
  def matchesTerm [DecidableEq Symbol] (pattern : Pattern Symbol) : Term Symbol → Bool
    | .node symbol terms =>
        match childTemplates pattern symbol terms.length with
        | none => false
        | some patterns => matchesChildren patterns terms

  /-- Execute pointwise matching of aligned children. -/
  def matchesChildren [DecidableEq Symbol] : List (Pattern Symbol) → List (Term Symbol) → Bool
    | [], [] => true
    | pattern :: patterns, term :: terms => matchesTerm pattern term && matchesChildren patterns terms
    | _, _ => false
end

namespace MicroCFTA.Language

/-- A finite ordered tree. The symbol has no imposed arity. -/
inductive Term (Symbol : Type) where
  | node : Symbol → List (Term Symbol) → Term Symbol

/-- Keep real symbols, unresolved holes, and recursion truncation distinct. -/
inductive PartialSymbol (Symbol : Type) where
  | concrete : Symbol → PartialSymbol Symbol
  | hole : Nat → PartialSymbol Symbol
  | truncated
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr
